title: Edit clip
cuesSavedBody: They will be burned in on the clip's next export.

range.title: Range in the original video
range.hint: Times are relative to the full video. “From player” adds the player position to the clip's current start.

cues.title: Subtitle text
cues.hint: Corrections are saved and burned in on the next export. The original transcript text is kept, so you can always compare with what was actually said.
cues.none: This clip has no subtitles (no transcript was available).

subtitleStyleHint: Applies on the next export. The preview is rendered the same way as the export.

export.title: Export again
export.titleCardHint: The clip title is shown in the first seconds.
export.hint: Export rebuilds the clip from the source with these settings.
export.noChanges: Nothing changed – exporting again will create the same file.

auto.label: Automatic (recommended)
auto.hint: Each part gets the layout that fits: reaction with a facecam, face tracking, or a center crop.

reaction.label: Reaction – content and camera
reaction.hint: Two panels: content and camera together, without cutting the face.

auto_face.label: Face tracking
auto_face.hint: Follows the dominant face. Without faces – a center crop.

center.label: Center crop
center.hint: Crops the middle of the frame. Always works.

split.label: Split screen (manual area)
split.hint: Camera on top and content below, using a camera area you mark.

blur_pad.label: Full frame on a blurred background
blur_pad.hint: Nothing is cut; the frame is smaller on a blurred background.

camera.title: Camera area
camera.hint: Drag a rectangle around the camera in the frame. The selection is saved with the clip.
camera.noFrame: Could not load a frame from the source (the source file may have been deleted). You can still enter values manually.
camera.frameAlt: A frame from the original video
camera.savedBody: It will be the default for future videos.

editStyle.title: Editing style
editStyle.hint: How much dead air is removed and whether the frame changes at cuts. Export builds a new plan.
